Police registered a case of culpable homicide not amounting to murder (BNS Section 105) against organisers after the Chorebagan stampede. Section 106 covers death by rash/negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide (up to 5 years + fine). 

Whether the CM, chairman or advisor face charges depends on probe evidence of their direct role, knowledge of risks and duty of care in crowd management. SIT is investigating; lower-level organisers already arrested. Liability is fact-specific.
